import importlib.util, importlib, sys, json, pathlib, hashlib, socket
package=pathlib.Path('/Applications/oMLX.app/Contents/Resources/Python/framework-mlx-base/lib/python3.11/site-packages/xgrammar')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('xgrammar',package/'__init__.py',submodule_search_locations=[str(package)])
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules['xgrammar']=module
# Load the unchanged native FFI directly: the broad Python package imports
# optional Torch helpers unavailable in the embedded MLX environment.
importlib.import_module('xgrammar.load_binding')
core=importlib.import_module('xgrammar.tvm_ffi_binding._ffi_api')

def refuse(*args,**kwargs):raise RuntimeError('Offline grammar verification')
socket.create_connection=refuse
info=core.TokenizerInfo([bytes([i]) for i in range(256)],0,256,[],False)
compiler=core.GrammarCompiler(info,1,False,-1)
samples=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/villa-p6-grammar-samples.json').read_text())
rows=[]
for case in samples['samples']:
 grammar=compiler.compile_json_schema(json.dumps(case['schema']),True,None,None,True,None,False)
 row={'case':case['name'],'validAccepted':0,'invalidRejected':0}
 for label in ['valid','invalid']:
  for value in case[label]:
   matcher=core.GrammarMatcher(grammar,None,True,-1)
   accepted=matcher.accept_string(json.dumps(value,separators=(',',':')),False) and matcher.is_completed()
   assert accepted == (label=='valid'), (case['name'],label,value)
   row['validAccepted' if label=='valid' else 'invalidRejected']+=1
 rows.append(row)
result={'scope':'Native XGrammar JSON grammar membership via unchanged installed FFI; no model inference, tokenizer inference, HTTP or server startup. This does not verify a hosted provider implementation.', 'sampleSha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/tmp/villa-p6-grammar-samples.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'rows':rows}
pathlib.Path('/tmp/villa-p6-grammar-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(result))
